title: Device credentials and pairing: hashed, 90-day sliding limit, short phone code
goal: A device pairs once with a short code and stays signed in until 90 days unused or revoked
acceptance: Starts after B-113 (PR #687) merges: it extends the session book (merged; the private-file writer is shared as savePrivateJson)
Device credential stored hashed with name, created and last use; lapses after 90 days without use; ended by admin token rotation
POST pairing endpoint swaps a one-use 8-character code (5 min, rate-limited) for a device credential; nerv open --phone mints it
A device credential has dashboard-session powers only (no login codes, revoke or stop)
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no personal data.
validation: A committed regression fails before the fix (test/device-pairing.test.ts)
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-23 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
